concepts.label: N1QL() Function Call
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a distinct invocation surface for SQL++ from a handler: N1QL(statementString, paramsArrayOrObject, optionsObject), where paramsArrayOrObject supplies positional ($1, $2, ...) or named ($mytype, ...) parameters and optionsObject can set isPrepared and consistency. This is a handler-specific JS-function calling convention, not the SQL++ statement grammar itself (n1ql:sqlpp).

concepts.label: N1QL Query Result Iterator
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the object returned by N1QL()/inline SQL++ inside a handler is a streamed, iterable result set that must be explicitly closed with results.close() to free resources - a runtime resource-management obligation specific to running SQL++ from inside an Eventing handler, not something a standalone SQL++ statement-reference page would ever need to mention.

relations.subject: eventing:n1ql-function-call
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: minted - no existing predicate captures a runtime obligation to release a returned handle/cursor after use; this is the constraint calling N1QL from a handler introduces that the SQL++ statement-reference rounds never saw (those describe query syntax/semantics, not a JS-side streamed-cursor lifecycle)
relations.evidence: results.close();              // End the query and free resources held
